title: Unavailable coordinates have zero query probability
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite type, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree whose available coordinates form a set $A\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. If $i\notin A$, then the structural query probability of coordinate $i$ in $T$, computed using $\pi$, is zero.
hypotheses_covered: π is a probability mass function on Ω
A finite decision tree T with available coordinates A
A coordinate i not in A
